blocks.text: Molecular biology ne haal mein irtiqai rishton ke baare mein bohat maloomat di hai. Jaise janwaron ke homologous dhaanche hain waise hi un ke homologous hayati kimiyai maadde bhi hain, kyunke banawat aur kaam genetic naqshe, DNA, par qaim hain jo sab jandaron mein hai.

Mutaliq janwaron ka DNA mushtarka buzurg se mila milta julta hota hai, aur kyunke DNA proteins ka code deta hai is liye un ke proteins bhi milte julte hain. Sciencedan mukhtalif jandaron ka DNA aur proteins nikal kar jaanchte hain; mutaliq molecules ke farq gin kar aur mutation ki taqreeban yaksan raftaar maan kar woh andaza lagate hain ke do jandaron ka mushtarka buzurg molecule kitna pehle tha.

blocks.title: Jaraseem mein antibiotics ke khilaf muzahimat kaise paida hui?
blocks.text: Antibiotic resistance ka matlab hai bacteria antibiotic ke saamne bhi zinda reh sakte hain. Yeh bacterial genes ki mutations se ho sakti hai; antibiotic ke istemal par natural selection se pasandeeda muzahimat ka gene bacteria ki agli naslon mein muntaqil hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Protein ke farq se do species ke alag hone ka waqt kaise andaza lagaya ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Protein (ya DNA) ke silsile ke farq ginein; yeh maan kar ke mutations taqreeban yaksan raftaar se jama hoti hain, zyada farq ka matlab mushtarka buzurg se zyada waqt.

items: Mutaliq jandaron ka DNA aur proteins milte julte (homologous biochemicals).
Molecular farq aur mutation ki raftaar se alag hone ka waqt.
Antibiotic resistance mutation aur natural selection se paida hoti hai.
